violations.text: Cake pops and Protein Balls prepared and packaged in the food establishment and set for customer self-selection at the counter refrigerator are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients and allergens, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. PIC is to maintain food items prepared and packaged on site behind the counter (to be handed to the customers by employee) until proper labels are created. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026
The door to the employee/customer toilet room is not self-closing. Self-closing mechanism to be added. New Violation. Correct By: 10/10/2026

The ice machine is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2024
